top_signals.title: Why the Yen Is Surrendering Intervention Gains
top_signals.summary: The yen is heading into the end of the week having surrendered nearly half of its intervention-driven gains, fueling speculation among traders that authorities may step into the market again. Bloomberg's David Finnerty breaks down how traders see recent FX moves. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Senate pushes CLARITY Act vote to September: Report
top_signals.summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune reportedly confirmed that the chamber was “punting” the vote until September.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
